benchmark_kind: first execution of the relation-paged backend on real MetaQA data, over a modelled federation
protocol: MP-SPDZ Semi, three local parties. Threat model unchanged: any two of three servers may collude.
scope_warning: A 200-entity connected subgraph of real MetaQA, one query, single host. All three parties ran on one machine, which does not instantiate the non-collusion assumption. This is real DATA at small SCALE; it is not a full-MetaQA evaluation, which has still never been run for this backend.
why_this_matters: Every prior paged-backend measurement used synthetic fixtures from scripts/build_skewed_fixture.py. This is the first run on edges taken from the real knowledge graph, over a federation split the way institutions plausibly would be.

data.sampling: connected snowball from seed 'Kismet', skipping sources above degree 40 so a single attribute hub cannot dominate the sample the way Drama dominates the full graph

federation.rule: by relation type, three owners -- institutions holding different record types, rather than the random 50/50 edge partition the bundled split uses
federation.evidence_handles: owner-blind, drawn uniformly from the 2^50 space with an independent generator per owner; handles_leak_owner confirms the ranges interleave

retention_at_bound_2.important_interaction: This 1.05x is far below the 1.55x measured on a whole owner's data in metaqa_real_degree_profile.json, and the reason is that the two mechanisms INTERACT. Splitting the federation by relation type already gives each owner only about three relations, so within an owner a source-keyed bound and a relation-keyed bound are nearly the same thing. Relation keying pays most when one owner holds many relations. Choosing a relation-type federation therefore spends most of the benefit the relation-paged layout would otherwise provide.

what_this_establishes: The relation-paged backend runs correctly on real MetaQA edges, not only on synthetic fixtures.
It runs over a realistic federation with genuine volume skew (1.78x) and owner-blind evidence handles.
The full preparation path -- owner-local layout, independent sharing, assembly, circuit, client reconstruction -- works end to end on real data.
what_this_does_not_establish: Any full-MetaQA result; this is 200 entities of 43,234, chosen to be runnable.
A speed advantage over the packed scan; that was not measured here and the narrowing factor on real MetaQA is 1.00.
That the relation-type federation is the right model; it is defensible and it is what makes the volume-hiding case, but it also suppresses most of the relation-keying benefit, as noted above.
Any WAN, multi-host, or malicious-security property.
